title: How to create a quest
summary: From an empty project to publishing: five steps every Meander author goes through.

shots.title: Start in “My quests”
shots.caption: The “Create quest” button opens an empty project. You can change the title and cover at any time.

shots.title: Build the first screen
shots.caption: A node is one game screen. Put text, images, buttons and other blocks into it, just like in a builder.

shots.title: Set up events
shots.caption: A node has events: what happens on enter, on press and when a variable changes. That is the logic of your game.

shots.title: Connect nodes with links
shots.caption: A link takes the player from one node to another. Mark the start node — that is where the game begins.

shots.title: Playtest and publish
shots.caption: Play through your quest in preview, check the text and buttons, then send it for moderation.
